name: Prince Housing & Development Corp.
summary: Prince Housing & Development Corp. engages in the land development business in Taiwan. It operates through Construction, Hotel, and Other segments. The company develops and sells residential properties, public housing, and buildings. It also engages in the construction, leasing, and sale of public housing, commercial buildings, tourism and recreation venues, children's playgrounds, water parks, and parking lots and towers, as well as the leasing and sale of real estate properties.
